claims.text: The proposed embedding approach boosts the average precision of BM25 by 19% on TREC 2006 and 6% on TREC 2007.
The proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 in ranking quality as shown in experiments on TREC datasets.
The semantic measure combined with BM25 improves performance, indicating a significant advantage over BM25 alone.
